visualCharacteristics.layout: Stacked light-grey (#f4f4f4) rounded rows with a chevron on the right; the answer opens below the question. Native <details>/<summary>, keyboard accessible

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: question cell (plain text) and answer cell (rich text: paragraphs, lists, links including mailto)
contentPattern.example: 11 FAQ items, e.g. 'What's the best way to apply for a position at Blue Shield of California?' | 'Search and apply for a job on our careers site...'

notes: How to get hired FAQ: authored as 'Accordion'

reuseGuidance: Use 'Accordion' for FAQ-style question/answer lists. Keep the question in the first cell as plain text; anything after it goes in the answer.
